PROCEDURE CODE
1152
Sealing may be ordered notwithstanding any provision to the contrary.   
It is carried out by the justice of the peace of the canton in which the objects to be sealed 
are located.
The justice of the peace uses a special seal which remains in his hands and the impression of which is deposited at the registry of the court of first instance.
All interested parties may attend the proceedings, although they need not be expressly invited to do so.
